target: Hon pekar ut felet hela tiden med familjen.

english: The undersigned requests leave of absence from the fifteenth to the twentieth.

english: Make sure we tighten the lid properly so nothing spills during transport.

english: After dinner she wipes the table and puts the dishes in the dishwasher.

english: Such food I like, simple home cooking with fresh ingredients from the garden.

english: After a stressful day, I unwind by taking a long walk along the waterfront.

english: The early bird catches the worm, so I always try to start my day early.

english: We pick up the trash.

english: We hand out the prizes.

english: We have managed so far.

english: She grits her teeth and fights.

target: Gå kan jag, men inte springa.
english: Walk I can, but not run.

english: You I want to talk to.

english: More time we would have needed.

english: More often than not it rains.

target: Inte heller i Stockholm har jag bott.
english: Neither in Stockholm have I lived.

english: To my knowledge there's no evidence.
grammar: "Mig veterligen" = to my knowledge. Formal/literary.

target: Långsamt vaknade staden till liv.
english: Slowly the city awoke to life.
grammar: Adverb fronting in literary style creates atmosphere and rhythm.

target: Snön gnisslade under hans stövlar.
english: The snow crunched under his boots.
grammar: "Gnissla" = crunch/squeak. Onomatopoeia — Swedish has many such expressive verbs.

target: Snöflingorna virvlade som dansande andar.
english: The snowflakes swirled like dancing spirits.

english: We move on to the next point.

english: From this one can draw the conclusion.

english: It was with great surprise I heard.

target: Emedan solen sken var alla glada.
english: As the sun shone, everyone was happy.
grammar: "Emedan" = as/since. Archaic/formal — rarely used in speech.

target: Delfinen hoppar elegant över de blå vågorna.
english: The dolphin jumps elegantly over the blue waves.

english: Not even once did he think about it.

english: How beautiful it was in the morning already!

english: The paleontologist found a fossil of a dinosaur.

english: So tired was he that he fell asleep.

english: It was not at all what I expected.

english: The old man's eyes told more than words.

english: From this it follows that we must act now.

english: Spotify was founded in Stockholm right now during summer.

target: Det är alltid trevligt att komma tillbaka hem till Sverige.
english: It is always nice to come back home to Sweden.
grammar: 'Tillbaka' (back) as a particle: 'komma tillbaka' (come back), 'ge tillbaka' (give back).

target: Flamingon står på ett ben vid den grunda sjön.
english: The flamingo stands on one leg by the shallow lake.

target: Bort flög fågeln under veckan med familjen.
english: Away flew the bird during the week with the family.

target: Hur svårt det än är ger jag inte upp.
english: No matter how hard it is, I won't give up.

target: Låt oss gå ut och fira att vi äntligen ses igen!
english: Let us go out and celebrate that we finally meet again!
grammar: 'Ut' (out) as a particle: 'gå ut' (go out), 'ta ut' (take out), 'se ut' (look/appear).

target: Jag glömde att stänga av spisen innan vi gick ut.
english: I forgot to turn off the stove before we went out.

target: Ljusets dans på vattenytan skapade rörliga mönster.

target: Så fort jag kom hem från jobbet somnade jag direkt.

target: Ju mer du övar på att prata svenska, desto mer självsäker kommer du att bli.
english: The more you practise speaking Swedish, the more confident you will become.

target: Oaktat problemen slutfördes projektet på morgonen till slut.
english: Notwithstanding the problems, the project was completed in the morning in the end.
grammar: "Oaktat" = notwithstanding. Very formal written Swedish.

target: Hon dyker upp oväntat vid dörren med blommor och en flaska vin.
english: She shows up unexpectedly at the door with flowers and a bottle of wine.

english: Next year we will merge the departments to save costs and work more efficiently.

target: Sjunga kan hon verkligen, hon vann talangshown tre år i rad.
english: Sing she really can, she won the talent show three years in a row.

english: In came the children from the rain, laughing and dripping wet all over the floor.

target: Vi har helt enkelt tur.

target: Hon har till slut lyckats.
english: She has finally succeeded.

target: De har verkligen imponerat.
english: They have really impressed.

target: Vi har praktiskt taget avslutat.
english: We have practically finished.

target: Jag har alltid gillat Sverige.
english: I have always liked Sweden.

target: Jag har förmodligen haft fel.
english: I have probably been wrong.

target: Vi har knappast hunnit.

target: Jag har med säkerhet sett det förut.

target: Springa orkar jag inte.

target: När som helst kan det hända.

target: Vad du än säger lyssnar hon inte.

target: Enbart genom samarbete kan vi lyckas.

target: Bara tillsammans klarar vi det.

target: Jag syns inte i mörkret.

target: Jag har länge velat besöka Gotland.

target: Vilken dag det var i helgen redan!

english: He leaned against the trunk of the old oak.

target: Det finns en påtaglig variation.

target: Vi har äntligen nått toppen.

target: Jag minns sommaren i Dalarna.
english: I remember the summer in Dalarna.

target: Horisonten sträckte sig oändligt framför dem.
english: The horizon stretched endlessly before them.

target: Isen knagrade under deras fötter.
english: The ice crackled under their feet.

target: Respondenternas svar kodades tematiskt.
english: The respondents' answers were coded thematically.

target: Perspektivet möjliggör en bredare förståelse.
english: The perspective enables a broader understanding.

target: Vi trivs bra här förra veckan också.
english: We are happy here last week too.

target: Den mörka natten sänkte sig över landskapet.

target: Orden fastnade som taggar i minnet.

english: A feeling of melancholy filled her chest.
grammar: "Vemod" is a uniquely Scandinavian form of bittersweet sadness.

target: Åren gick, men minnena bestod.

target: En ensam fågel sjöng sin sista visa.
english: A solitary bird sang its last song.

target: Vinden viskade hemligheter genom björkarna.
english: The wind whispered secrets through the birches.

target: Varje steg på den knarrande trappan ljöd.

english: Data was collected during a three-month period.

target: Diskussionen kretsar kring tre huvudteman.
english: The discussion revolves around three main themes.

target: Den svenska modellen kombinerar marknad och välfärd.
english: The Swedish model combines market and welfare.

target: Aldrig förr hade jag sett något sådant.

target: Minnet av sommarens dagar värmde hennes hjärta.
english: The memory of summer days warmed her heart.

target: Klockorna i kyrktornent slog tolv.
english: The bells in the church tower struck twelve.

target: Under midnattssolen förlorade tiden sin mening.
english: Under the midnight sun, time lost its meaning.
grammar: The midnight sun in northern Sweden means the sun never sets during summer.

target: Det var en tid som aldrig skulle återvända.
english: It was a time that would never return.

target: Skeppet gled tyst genom den spegelblanka fjorden.
english: The ship glided silently through the mirror-smooth fjord.

target: I det avlägsna förflutna hade allt varit annorlunda.
english: In the distant past everything had been different.

target: Med ens steg en gestalt fram ur skuggorna.
english: Suddenly a figure stepped out from the shadows.

target: Skönheten i det förgängliga fångade hans blick.
english: The beauty in the transient caught his eye.

target: Deras öde var beseglat av det sagda.
english: Their fate was sealed by what was said.

target: I gryningens ljus tedde sig allt annorlunda.
english: In the light of dawn, everything appeared different.

target: Hon har alltid drömt om att besöka Nya Zeeland.
english: She has always dreamed of visiting New Zealand.

target: Slutsatsen är att det behövs fler studier.
english: The conclusion is that more studies are needed.

target: Resultatet är statistiskt signifikant i biblioteket.
english: The result is statistically significant in the library.

target: Kontextuella faktorer spelar en avgörande roll med vänner.
english: Contextual factors play a decisive role with friends.

target: Lund är en av Sveriges äldsta universitetsstäder.
english: Lund is one of Sweden's oldest university cities.

target: I fjärran hördes ljudet av bjällror.
english: In the distance the sound of bells was heard.
grammar: "I fjärran" = in the distance (literary). "Hördes" = was heard (s-passive).

target: Han bar med sig en hemlighet som tyngde.
english: He carried with him a secret that weighed heavy.

target: Tidvattnet bar med sig vrakdelar från det förflutna.
english: The tide carried with it wreckage from the past.
grammar: "Det förflutna" = the past (literary). "Vrakdelar" = wreckage (compound).

target: Skuggorna dansade i ljuset av brasan.
english: The shadows danced in the light of the fire.

target: Den förbipasserande skogsduvan kutade genom dimman verkligen.
english: The passing wood pigeon cooed through the fog really.

target: Havets röst var en ständig följeslagare.
english: The voice of the sea was a constant companion.

target: Bergstoppen stod klar mot den blånande himlen.
english: The mountain peak stood clear against the blue sky.

target: Doften av nyslaget hö fyllde luften.
english: The scent of freshly cut hay filled the air.

target: En väg, knappt synlig, ledde in bland träden.
english: A road, barely visible, led in among the trees.

target: Varje dröm bär fröet till sin egen fullbordan.
english: Every dream carries the seed of its own fulfillment.

target: Det bleka ljuset kastade långa skuggor till slut.
english: The pale light cast long shadows in the end.

target: Den etnografiska metoden gav djupare insikter till slut.
english: The ethnographic method provided deeper insights in the end.

target: Det normkritiska förhållningssättet utmanar traditionella antaganden om könsroller.
english: The norm-critical approach challenges traditional assumptions about gender roles.

target: Kräftorna äts med dill och bröd också.
english: The crayfish are eaten with dill and bread too.

target: Ishotellet i Jukkasjärvi byggs varje vinter.
english: The Ice Hotel in Jukkasjärvi is built every winter.

target: Vi har förberett allting inför det stora mötet på måndag.
english: We have prepared everything for the big meeting on Monday.

target: Det råder konsensus om att utbildningssystemet behöver en grundläggande reform.
english: There is consensus that the education system needs fundamental reform.

target: Hej då, vi ses igen nästa vecka på jobbet.
english: Goodbye, we will see each other next week at work.

target: Allemansrätten ger alla tillgång till naturen.
english: The right of public access gives everyone access to nature.
grammar: Allemansrätten is unique to Sweden — you can hike, camp, and pick berries on any land.

target: Småprat är inte lika vanligt som i andra länder.
english: Small talk is not as common as in other countries.
